constraints.statement: TGA packages MUST NOT treat essay provenance as runtime evidence. Runtime evidence MUST be expressed through package evidence fields or TIS-compatible evidence bundles.
TGA runtime assurance examples MUST preserve the distinction between registry publication and runtime authorization.
A consequential TGA runtime decision MUST identify authority boundary, policy reference, evidence reference, status or revocation check, decision outcome, admitted effect, and redress route.

TGA packages that depend on external validation SHOULD include a TIS artifact projection covering authority boundary, evidence bundle, evaluation envelope, decision receipt, and registry publication profile.
TGA assurance posture labels MUST NOT be treated as TIS AL1-AL4 assurance levels unless an explicit TIS assurance artifact is present.
